points.description: States that the number of comparisons is related to the height of the tree (equivalently, about log of the number of elements, e.g. log n for a balanced tree).
points.partial_credit: Half or more if vague, e.g. says it depends on depth/levels or 'log' without saying of what, or gives the right idea with a minor error.

points.description: Gives both equivalent forms or ties them together: height of the tree, and log of the number of elements (log n).

rubric.notes: Full marks for saying the comparisons equal the tree's height or about log n (n = number of elements), in any wording. Part marks for vague answers such as 'depends on the depth' or 'log' without context. No marks for answers like n comparisons, constant, or only describing how search works without giving the count.
